# Chapter 3-c — Group A: C-READ, telling identity and persistence

**Document:** `NH_MASTER-21_SYSTEM_BEHAVIOR_v0_1_CANDIDATE__CH03-c.md`  
**Status:** CANDIDATE  
**Source repository:** `nesgeva/NH-GOVERNANCE`  
**Source commit:** `855459fc6674dfe3a1f310f3d1690a9e7db59405`

This piece continues C-READ after the passed Chapter 3-b. It carries the accepted A2 telling-record and reading-to-telling persistence contract, its complete preparation/commit/recovery and semantic-eligibility rules, the telling-reference handoff, and the later accepted qualitative firmness policy. C-7K remains the owner of Story-Layer cards and organization; the payload and reference contracts are described here because the reading operation prepares, preserves and commits them. This does not complete the remaining Group A components or the B16 promotion/evaluation packages.

Authority order: V10 → Decision Defaults v2_2 → cursorrules → Companion v1; the Working Map is subordinate. ACCEPTED identifies standalone content supported by its acceptance receipt, not implementation. No new behavior in this piece is stamped BUILT. The existing built reading shape/writer remains as described in Chapter 3-b; no A2 preparation, card writer, event or gate is inferred to exist in code. The passed DECIDED-2026-09-25 bootstrap/memory-health rules and the ACCEPTED B24 context guard are preserved in Chapter 3-b without restamping.

Citation keys: V10 = `01_AUTHORITATIVE/NH_MASTER-20_CORRECTED_v10.md`; DD = `01_AUTHORITATIVE/NH_DECISION_DEFAULTS-S19_v2_2.md`; CR = `01_AUTHORITATIVE/cursorrules`; COMP = `01_AUTHORITATIVE/NH_PROJECT_COMPANION_GOVERNANCE_AND_ARCHIVE_v1.md`; MAP = `02_WORKING_MAP/NH_COMPLETE_DESIGN_AND_WIRING_MAP_v1_6_CANDIDATE.md`; `04/` = `04_ACCEPTED_STANDALONE_DESIGNS/`. NHD-A2 and NHD-SLF are navigation IDs only; behavior comes from the cited accepted source sections.

Template convention: record-member and rule sub-parts describe the contents and behavior of their containing part, not separate runtime services. Their reciprocal Fed by / USED BY rows express that containment; procedure rows express operations. An exact serialized type, field spelling, algorithm or threshold is not invented where the source supplies only a semantic contract. The single durable recovery object is named prepared_reading_telling_envelope throughout; references to a manifest denote that object, not an additional store.

ALONE
- What it is: ACCEPTED — The complete immutable first-class telling payload assembled and preserved by the reading operation; the Story Layer owns the eventual card. Recovery copies do not acquire canonical ownership. [04/NH_A2_TELLING_OBJECT_IDENTITY_PACKAGE_v1_8_CANDIDATE.md §2] [NHD-A2]
- Takes in: ACCEPTED — Accepted semantic telling values, source-carried speaker identity, resolved supporting roots and mechanically assigned record provenance. [04/NH_A2_TELLING_OBJECT_IDENTITY_PACKAGE_v1_8_CANDIDATE.md §2] [NHD-A2]
- Does: ACCEPTED — Carries one telling under one permanent telling_id, linked to its immutable parent reading and supporting roots; preserves every populated embedded value exactly. [04/NH_A2_TELLING_OBJECT_IDENTITY_PACKAGE_v1_8_CANDIDATE.md §2] [NHD-A2]

- Fed by: ACCEPTED — C-READ.10.3.1 — Complete semantic acceptance: The proposal contains each complete semantic card payload and its embedded entry. - Fed by: ACCEPTED — C-READ.10.3.2 — No partial salvage: A proposal failing a required condition is rejected with its specific reason. This persistence path cannot strip an invalid telling, manufacture an empty story_layer, repair the proposal, or turn rejected material into accepted output. ### C-READ.10.6.3 — Telling-completion checkpoint
Stamp: ACCEPTED    Source: [04/NH_A2_TELLING_OBJECT_IDENTITY_PACKAGE_v1_8_CANDIDATE.md §4.4.1] [NHD-A2]

ALONE
- What it is: ACCEPTED — The single append-only proof that the reading’s telling set is complete or legitimately empty. [04/NH_A2_TELLING_OBJECT_IDENTITY_PACKAGE_v1_8_CANDIDATE.md §4.4.1] [NHD-A2]
- Takes in: ACCEPTED — Expected count and discriminator/card inventory; every required card and commit event; passing integrity/correspondence results. [04/NH_A2_TELLING_OBJECT_IDENTITY_PACKAGE_v1_8_CANDIDATE.md §4.4.1] [NHD-A2]
- Does: ACCEPTED — Appends one checkpoint under an identity derived from stable reading/preparation identity plus a completion-operation-version tag; repeated appends are no-ops. [04/NH_A2_TELLING_OBJECT_IDENTITY_PACKAGE_v1_8_CANDIDATE.md §4.4.1] [NHD-A2]
- Gives out: ACCEPTED — A complete-card-set checkpoint or legitimate-zero-telling sentinel. [04/NH_A2_TELLING_OBJECT_IDENTITY_PACKAGE_v1_8_CANDIDATE.md §4.4.1] [NHD-A2]
- Must never: ACCEPTED — Append completion while any expected card/event is absent or invalid, or substitute silence for an explicit zero-telling result. [04/NH_A2_TELLING_OBJECT_IDENTITY_PACKAGE_v1_8_CANDIDATE.md §4.4.1] [NHD-A2]
- Fails closed by: ACCEPTED — Keeps telling-specific semantic use blocked while the expected card/event set or valid completion proof is missing or invalid; preserves the immutable parent reading and its completed lifecycle. [04/NH_A2_TELLING_OBJECT_IDENTITY_PACKAGE_v1_8_CANDIDATE.md §4.4.1] [NHD-A2] [04/NH_A2_TELLING_OBJECT_IDENTITY_PACKAGE_v1_8_CANDIDATE.md §5A.1] [NHD-A2]

### Accepted-source scope and later owners

| Matter | Treatment in this piece |
|---|---|
| V10’s unresolved telling identity | A2 §1–§2 supplies the accepted standalone separate-card contract; V10’s lack of a built first-class card remains unchanged. An open slot is not treated as a prohibition against recording its accepted standalone design. |
| A2’s earlier open firmness scale | The later accepted firmness policy supplies the six qualitative outcomes, mandatory non-omitted basis, omission-by-absence and no-numeric-scoring rules. The older open note is not repeated as a current missing decision. |
| A2’s earlier B24/B9/B10 and related open-package notes | These are scoped dependency statements in frozen source files, not current proof that accepted packages are absent. This piece consumes acceptance/retry/reread boundaries; their complete owning mechanisms remain for their own templates. No retry count or provider is chosen here. |
| B16 promotion and evaluation evidence | Remain subsequent Chapter 3 scope. The A2 invariant—telling eligibility never outruns the parent—does not substitute for the promotion architecture or its evaluation-evidence bridge. |
| Theme, Person-Box, clash, Computed View and Living State Web mechanics | Only the accepted A2 telling-ID interface is placed here. Owning Group D schemas, policies and full behavior remain for that group; they are not declared globally undecided from A2’s historical open list. |
| New restoration content | None. The passed Chapter 3-b restoration and carried-guard classifications remain unchanged. No archive source supplies behavior in this piece. |
